chapters.label: Live: the 2021 final
chapters.text: The 2021 Futsal World Cup final in Kaunas. Portugal play Argentina. Pany Varela scores Portugal’s first goal! Later he scores again. Two to one, and Portugal are world champions!

chapters.label: How he does it
chapters.text: His big weapon was the one against one. Watch how he does it. He shows the defender the inside, and the defender leans. Then he goes outside, and shoots fast!

chapters.label: Practise it
chapters.text: Now you try. In a one against one, fake one way and go the other. Then shoot fast, before the defender gets back!
